title: Dust, which helps enterprises design and deploy specialized AI agents that work alongside humans, raised a $40M Series B led by Abstract and Sequoia (Chris Metinko/Axios)
summary: Chris Metinko / Axios: Dust, which helps enterprises design and deploy specialized AI agents that work alongside humans, raised a $40M Series B led by Abstract and Sequoia — Dust, a human-agent collaboration platform, raised a $40 million Series B led by Abstract and Sequoia, CEO Gabriel Hubert tells Axios Pro exclusively.
